datasets.title: Nepal: Transportation Hubs
datasets.description: This dataset includes airports, train stations, and terminals from the Overture Places theme, derived from Meta and Microsoft open data. Read more at https://docs.overturemaps.org/guides/places/. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/osgeonepal_npl_transportation_hubs]
datasets.details: Contains transportation points of interest (e.g., airports, stations) from Meta and Microsoft via Overture Places. Licensed under CDLA Permissive 2.0. Data might contain errors and was processed and published using the Overture public release via the overture2hdx package.

lineage.description: Transportation hub locations and attributes were extracted from the Overture Places theme, an open-source geographic dataset derived from Meta and Microsoft data sources. The dataset was compiled and distributed by OSGeo Nepal in geopackage and shapefile formats for Nepal's national transportation infrastructure.
